searchText: Spam? Was thinking maybe just, off-topic? Tho, NFTs on Ethereum with R&D on an interplanetary terminal also feels kind of on-topic. Is it real though, or some scam? Oh, she's real. Source in open: https://github.com/t3rmdotdev Also published on all contracts Your infura id is hardcoded and visible in that code <@&595685821026271242> Spam: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/595721451651465227/884233602047565844 and https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/595721451651465227/884283802275422268 My bad if that's considered spam, I'll delete myself This is not the appropriate channel for troubleshooting/tech support of Ethereum contracts. So, it's off topic for the channel... off-topic? My bad. Removed. I suspect you knew that since you posted with a brand new Discord account rather than your main account. In my experience, the only time people post advertisements with shill accounts is when they know what they are doing is against the rules. It was more an error on quick filtering. Scanning the list of channels, then a call on which felt like the best place to share news with fellow community minded individuals. In ethglobal, it was a perfect fit for random chat. Although now that you mention it, maybe not. Don't want to pollute <#692062809701482577>, for apps that need old receipts, do they (generally speaking) need them *right now* or can they wait until they are fetched? And for clients that don't have them and need to fetch them: do they need to have a direct peer that has them or can they advertise they need these receipts and their message is passed along? Depends heavily on the app I believe.
